patterns: Public inventory lives on https://api.spothero.com/v2 (search/transient); account APIs on https://spothero.com/api/v1

novel_features.name: Best pick
novel_features.description: Get one ranked parking pick plus alternatives for a place and time window.
novel_features.rationale: Ranks live inventory by total price and walking distance with your limits applied, which the site leaves to you.
novel_features.example: spothero-pp-cli best --address "233 S Wacker Dr, Chicago, IL" --starts 2027-01-15T09:00 --ends 2027-01-15T12:00 --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when asked to pick a garage rather than list them.

novel_features.name: Booking preflight
novel_features.description: Check session, vehicle, card, overlaps and spend cap before you try to book.
novel_features.rationale: Joins account, reservation and quote data into one read-only verdict.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run this before asking an owner to approve a booking.

novel_features.name: Next pass
novel_features.description: See your soonest upcoming reservation and when it starts.
novel_features.rationale: Selects from your reservations with time math the list view does not do.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for what parking do I have next.

novel_features.name: Rebook preview
novel_features.description: Re-quote a past reservation's garage for a new window and compare with what you paid.
novel_features.rationale: Joins a past reservation to a fresh quote; it never places anything.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when the owner wants the same garage again.

novel_features.name: Refund view
novel_features.description: See refund status across upcoming reservations at once.
novel_features.rationale: Calls eligibility per reservation and joins the results.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before cancelling or when plans change.

novel_features.name: Commute plan
novel_features.description: Quote a recurring series of parking windows with a total.
novel_features.rationale: Expands weekdays into windows and paces quotes across them; it never places anything.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to budget a recurring commute.

novel_features.name: Regular garages
novel_features.description: See which garages you book most, with last booked and last price.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates reservation history from the local store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to resolve my usual garage.

narrative.headline: Find, quote, book and cancel SpotHero parking from the terminal, with spend caps and hard gates.
narrative.value_prop: SpotHero only offers an API to business partners. This CLI uses the same consumer endpoints as spothero.com, signs in from your Chrome session, and adds what a web checkout lacks for agents: preflight checks, --max-total spend caps, and explicit gates on anything that charges or refunds.
narrative.auth_narrative: Sign in at spothero.com in Chrome, then run auth login --chrome. The CLI reads the AUTH_TOKEN session cookie directly from your Chrome profile, decrypting it with the Chrome Safe Storage key (macOS may ask once for Keychain access), and only saves it after the API accepts it. No token copying. The session lasts about 30 days. auth status re-checks against the API every time. You can also use --cookies-file or the SPOTHERO_COOKIES env var.

quickstart.comment: Import and verify your Chrome session

quickstart.command: spothero-pp-cli find --address "233 S Wacker Dr, Chicago, IL" --starts 2027-01-15T09:00 --ends 2027-01-15T12:00 --agent

troubleshoots.symptom: auth login says the session was rejected
troubleshoots.fix: Sign in at https://spothero.com in Chrome, wait a minute for Chrome to write cookies to disk, then rerun spothero-pp-cli auth login --chrome

troubleshoots.symptom: auth login --chrome cannot read the Keychain
troubleshoots.fix: Allow the macOS prompt for Chrome Safe Storage, or use spothero-pp-cli auth login --cookies-file <path>

troubleshoots.symptom: book place reports an ambiguous result
troubleshoots.fix: Do not rerun it. Run spothero-pp-cli reservations list --agent and look for the new reservation first

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to search SpotHero parking, quote a garage, check upcoming reservations and refund status, and, only with the owner's explicit approval for that exact booking or cancellation, to book or cancel.
anti_triggers: Do not use for monthly parking subscriptions; book and cancel cover hourly reservations
Do not use the partner X-API-Key API with this CLI
Do not book or cancel from an inferred request; the owner must approve that exact action
